description: Header file defining the ssb_scheduler class responsible for scheduling synchronization signal blocks (SSB) in a 5G NR network simulation or implementation. It includes method declarations for scheduling, allocation, and configuration of SSBs, as well as private helper functions and member variables.

classes.name: ssb_scheduler
classes.description: Class responsible for scheduling SSBs in a 5G NR network, including methods for slot scheduling, grant scheduling, and SSB allocation based on different cases.

methods.name: ssb_scheduler
methods.description: Constructor initializing the scheduler with cell configuration.

methods.name: run_slot
methods.description: Schedules SSB grants for a given slot, considering periodicity and slot information.

methods.name: schedule_ssb
methods.description: Schedules SSB grants for a slot, depending on the SSB case and frequency.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Deactivates the scheduler when the cell is deactivated.

methods.name: ssb_alloc_case_A_C
methods.description: Performs SSB allocation for cases A and C as per 3GPP TS 38.213.

methods.name: ssb_alloc_case_B
methods.description: Performs SSB allocation for case B as per 3GPP TS 38.213.

methods.name: ssb_alloc_case_D
methods.description: Performs SSB allocation for case D in FR2 with 120kHz SCS as per 3GPP TS 38.213.

methods.name: fill_ssb_parameters
methods.description: Fills in SSB parameters such as offset, subcarrier offset, and burst index.
